correctness.rationale: The metric transportation norm is half the zero-sum coordinate ell-one norm. A direct signed-chamber Jacobian, two Vandermonde identities and Dirichlet second moments prove the exact normalized covariance and isotropic constant. The CLT uses the independent exponential representation, exact delta-method variance 4, hypergeometric K/n to one half, and independent normal contributions of variance 1/2 each; the radial factor contributes only lower-order error. Independent exact-rational hull integrations for dimensions 3 to 6 and moment identities to 23 corroborate but do not replace the analytic proof.

The equilateral volume and sign-chamber partition are published earlier and explicitly excluded. Comparisons found no inspected stronger covering statement while recognizing unindexed-equivalence and general-section-CLT risks.

No independent mathematical review or external certification has been performed.

value.rationale: Isotropic covariance and centered radial fluctuations are natural bulk invariants of a canonical infinite family of finite-dimensional Banach balls. The proved exact Gaussian law and asymptotic isotropic constant go beyond the known volume/facet data; the exact hypergeometric–Dirichlet sampler is structurally useful for moment calculations. The domain is natural and the claim is not a finite arbitrary parameter slice or a routine renamed volume formula.
